name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent patch releases across multiple supported versions simultaneously. The latest release is v0.63.16 (Open Source) / v1.63.16 (Enterprise), released on September 1, 2025. Multiple version branches (58.x through 63.x) are receiving concurrent patch updates, indicating a robust long-term support strategy. Release notes are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases, with both Docker images and JAR downloads provided for each edition.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license (Metabase Commercial License)
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across 6 concurrent version branches as recently as September 1, 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, Druid, Oracle, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers superior visualization capabilities and enterprise polish, but is proprietary, expensive, and lacks the open-source self-hosted flexibility of Metabase.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash is a modern open-source alternative tightly integrated with dbt, making it ideal for dbt-heavy teams, but it requires a dbt project as a prerequisite unlike Metabase.
